verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of GitHub code search. The only on-topic item is a community comment that GitHub's code search exists but is 'terribly bad', so slow that cloning and grepping is more efficient. That confirms the capability exists but suggests poor quality, and nothing shows it works across repositories. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing code search, evidence of cross-repository/org-wide search scope, query syntax or filters, API access to code search, and positive hands-on corroboration.
